_comment: Instruction and image check (section 5.1.5), run by pilot/verify.py with each agent's verification build, three times per agent before the pilot and after the last run. 'decided': false marks wording not yet frozen.

prompts.instructions: Use the naoqi MCP server. Its instructions contain a verification word. Reply with only that word. Do not call any tool.
prompts.image: Use the naoqi MCP server. Call get_state once. The image in its result shows a code of six digits. Reply with only that code.
